system.description:
May be added to any weapon. Weapon length is one step shorter (-1 WL) than the weapon itself; adjust the length to suit. Modifications cost +1 rp per weapon (+4 rps for superior quality weapons; +3 rps for Elven Arms; +4 rps for Dwarven Arms).

Run of the Mill Arms cost 5 rps for the character's whole idiom of hand weapons (e.g. sword, lance and dagger for a knight).

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 555
